content:
Please stop creating new puzzles while leaving issues to the older ones unresolved, and stop disregarding previous feedback. Your contributions are flooding the contribution page.

I'd encourage you to focus on quality rather than quantity. While binary logic gates may seem like a good theme for multiple puzzles, the similarity and difficulty don't justify so many submissions as a chapter series or submissions as puzzles instead of clashes.

This problem already exists, and as a clash at that.

https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/47766d748d839104aa189cfb7c8d9f99c1e11
